governance_boundary: This matrix defines ablations and death rules only. It does not certify external support, consciousness, phenomenality, identity transfer, or bridge-burden closure.

entries.manipulation: Remove or randomize identity-channel binding while preserving gross trace length, event count, and response-coordinate dimensionality.
entries.primary_outcome: drop in trace_alignment_delta and failure of identity-preserving certificate
entries.support_rule: QICN margin remains positive after complexity penalty and all negative controls remain below the frozen decision threshold.
entries.weakening_rule: QICN beats the rival only after post-hoc exclusion, threshold change, or unsupported tolerance widening.
entries.destruction_rule: A rival model beats QICN after predeclared exclusions and complexity penalty, or the sham control reproduces the same effect.

entries.manipulation: Phase-shift the history-alignment channel while preserving local response energy and event counts.
entries.primary_outcome: selective contraction of history_binding_delta outside the ambiguity margin
entries.support_rule: Targeted history shift causes certified class exit/contraction while sham and global-noise controls do not.
entries.weakening_rule: Effect is present but indistinguishable from latency or global noise under 95% confidence interval propagation.
entries.destruction_rule: Verified history shift outside ambiguity margin produces no downgrade or the memory-only rival explains the response more parsimoniously.

entries.manipulation: Perturb response phase within predeclared pass/fail regions.
entries.primary_outcome: pass-region stability and fail-region non-recovery under frozen tolerance
entries.support_rule: Pass/fail behavior matches frozen region rules without threshold retuning.
entries.weakening_rule: Behavior depends on cherry-picked perturbations or collapses under held-out perturbation coordinates.
entries.destruction_rule: Fail-region cases recover or pass-region cases fail under the frozen panel at rates exceeding preregistered noise allowance.

entries.manipulation: Apply admissible gauge transformations and gauge-breaking transformations under matched observation channels.
entries.primary_outcome: gauge_response_delta remains stable for admissible transformations and contracts under gauge-breaking perturbations
entries.support_rule: Admissible gauge changes preserve the certificate while gauge-breaking changes fail, with adversarial controls below threshold.
entries.weakening_rule: Gauge response survives but only under a single seed, a single implementation, or non-frozen transformation family.
entries.destruction_rule: Gauge-breaking transformations preserve the certificate or admissible gauge transformations destroy it under frozen rules.

entries.manipulation: Construct factor-local product controls and compare them to connected response-separator incidence packages.
entries.primary_outcome: connected package has zero factor-local zero-crossing cuts; product control has disconnected components and nonzero zero-crossing cuts
entries.support_rule: The positive package passes and the product separator negative control fails under the same enumerator and hash policy.
entries.weakening_rule: Positive package passes only after post-hoc catalog edits or after excluding a disconnected response coordinate.
entries.destruction_rule: A factor-local product control passes the same connected-incidence atomicity gate.

v24_upgrade: Adds machine-readable frozen death-rule parameters so ablation rules do not depend on informal or unfrozen margins.
